newsitem.title: JAPAN: LTCB to submit risk control report by Oct 31--MOF.
newsitem.headline: LTCB to submit risk control report by Oct 31--MOF.

text.p: The Finance Ministry on Friday asked the Long-Term Credit Bank of Japan to submit a report by October 31 on how to improve internal risk controls at its overseas branches, a ministry official said.
The ministry earlier ordered the bank to beef up internal risk controls following a finding that the bank failed to report unauthorised trades in New York.

LTCB said in a statement on Friday that the bank has been taking necessary steps to strengthen its internal audit system for New York operation since "certain irregularities" were discovered in the securities lending business of LTCB Trust Company, a wholly-owned U.S. subsidiary of LTCB.

In August, the bank agreed to a $1 million settlement with U.S. regulators for failing to report unauthorised trades in bonds issued by the U.S. government-sponsored Federal National Mortgage Association.

"Also in response to the (MOF) instruction, LTCB will initiate full-scale measures to further improve and strengthen its internal control system for its overseas operations," the bank said in a statement.
